brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Configurator verifies only geometric fit and mesh clearance (meshClash=clear), not structural load capacity. Build provides shelf surfaces via covers on piece:-1,0,0, piece:1,0,0 and piece:0,0,1 and jointBolt stabilization, but no rated load certification can be made; do not use as load guarantee.

Placed two notch drawer frames: notch:0#-1,1#notch1 (between -1,0,0/0,0,0) and notch:0#0,1#notch1 (between 0,0,0/1,0,0) – both hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm, providing two functional drawer bays at level 0.

finish.summary: Built 3-wide base with centered second storey (4 pieces total, joint-bolted, 3 solid top covers as shelf surfaces) and two adjacent notch drawer frames on the front edge. Mesh clash clear. Load rating cannot be certified by configurator – fit only, not strength.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
